_why: TASK-818 (FE). One clicked test file (the dialog, the header entry, the wire). Each mutation breaks the REQUEST, who is told what, or a default the admin never chose. Written with the set; nothing reconstructed. NOT mutated, on purpose: the two `if (noDate || choosing) return;` waits inside submit — the button is already `disabled` for both, so a pressed-anyway click never reaches them (belt and braces, unreachable by a click). ALSO NOT mutated: the empty-date wait (`noDate`) — it is a second, redundant guard: an empty date is never an advance date, so `refusedForAdmin` already holds the button, and so does the admin door's own tick rule; removing either alone changes nothing observable. R6 (moving the start past the end keeps the old end) was dropped by TASK-822: the end is no longer dropped silently — it stays and is REFUSED in words; that refusal is guarded by set 822.
